description: Generate time-of-day reference images for a location board (costs credits per variant — check the price with get_cost first). Without `variants` the backend renders all four. The images are what makes a board usable as a visual reference.

get_cost.description: Free: the exact price of this run (per variant and total) — nothing is rendered or charged. Name it to the person before the real run.

variants.description: Which time-of-day variants to render. Allowed: day, night, golden_hour, rain. Omit for all of them. Fewer variants = fewer credits.

name: lab_generate_location_variants
title: Generate Location Variants
